posthoc_scope: Proposed after original large-domain mode fits showed >99.6% of local geometric m1 response as core translations, with material global symmetry error. No finite pure-impact Cartesian result inspected before this freeze.
hypothesis: Small opposite source-center displacements, with velocity directions held fixed, produce chiefly outgoing trajectory deflection. Cores retain charge and bounded intrinsic shape; centroid response should be linear in initial impact for .01/.02 and converge in space/time/box.
observables: Core x-centroid/impact, late slope, R12 charge retention, R8 charge covariance eigenvalues. Compare unshifted controls and the original axisymmetric linear core-position fits; do not equate R36 Cartesian canonical norms with whole-domain cylindrical norms.

criteria.retention: Same late tau120..160, >=90% initial Q in two nonoverlapping R12 cores, >=15% in each.
criteria.linearization: Fine centroid response x/impact changes <2% of response magnitude when impact .02 is halved.
criteria.space: Max late centroid-response difference medium/fine <5% of response magnitude and smaller than coarse/medium difference.
criteria.time_box: Each max late centroid-response change <5% of response magnitude.
criteria.shape: Report actual core covariance/charge changes vs matched reference. Bounded response over a finite interval is not a measured asymptotic Lyapunov exponent.
